timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Admins manage everything. What could go wrong?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Admins browsing email on the same machine that holds the keys. That's what.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: The tiered admin model. Separate access by impact.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Tier 0 is identity and control plane. Tier 1 servers and apps. Tier 2 workstations.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Higher-tier credentials must never touch lower-tier devices. No browsing on the admin box.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: PAWs. Hardened dedicated machines for Tier 0 and 1 admin. No email, no random browsing.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Phishing-resistant MFA and passwordless. Plus PIM for just-in-time elevation.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What if Conditional Access locks us out?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Break-glass accounts, heavily monitored, tested on a schedule.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Randomize local admin passwords and isolate service accounts. Stop the hop.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: So admin access is a ceremony?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: A deliberate, monitored ceremony. It's the vault door to everything.
